branch.js.note: forks the first answer it finds, so it needs a transcript; the stand-in writes none

comments-read.js.note: the PDF is named after a note stamped per run; the export dir is fresh, so the glob matches exactly one file (the check also logs it as pdfName)

doc.js.note: thread, not sample: on a vault with no thread its thread half reports 'not run'; the thread fixture is what serves it

find-bar.js.note: the thread half wants a thread long enough to scroll past its head

find-words.js.note: the sample holds the water note; the accented title it seeds itself, under a filename without the word it folds to

images.js.note: asks the model to name a colour only the pasted image shows

jot.js.note: the new-note timing check: an empty vault is filled with 1,500 notes (~60MB) through the app before the clock starts, so it runs long

land-loaded.js.note: the first run fills the strip, the second starts from the state file and is the check

lanes-none.js.note: starts with no lanes, then patches one in (Garden, on projects/garden) and waits for the rail to show it

limit-live.js.note: the README also runs it against the fault stand-in, where it passes on its no-card branch; one entry holds one stand-in, so that second run is not listed here

many-tabs.js.note: opens ten rail rows: the sample's hub/rim/spoke plus enough notes touched today to fill RECENT

models.js.note: not live: the stand-in's model probe refuses an id with a space in the CLI's own words and takes any other, which is all this asks

new-note-folder.js.note: makes three notes and reads back where they landed; another note in the vault would answer for them

new-note.js.note: makes projects/Reading/palette-probe.md by folder/name; the folder is made fresh in the sample

note-ops.js.note: waits up to 45 s for the vault sweep to index the link it seeded

palette-marks.js.note: forks the fixture's thread, so the fixture is laid down fresh for it

palette-skills.js.note: the sample holds echo-word, garden-check and quiet-one; the check's lane-named skill and its lane must match garden-check / Garden

pane-empty.js.note: the counted chip can wait up to 45 s for the vault sweep

pane-toggle.js.note: opens a thread row and two note rows; the thread fixture has one thread and five notes, the sample no thread

path-ticks.js.note: spends five turns with long answers, and forks

pdf.js.note: opens the sample's everything.md by its rail row

prompts-palette.js.note: The sample's skills are switched off: `/` alone must list the one prompt.

reveal-and-select.js.note: opens one Finder window when it passes; the rail-row half can wait for the vault sweep

roles.js.note: the thread fixture runs both halves: a note row and a thread row

roundtrip.js.note: waits up to 45 s for the vault sweep to index the last save

schedule-live.js.note: waits for a real minute to come round and for the scheduler's own thirty-second look

signed-out.js.note: the stand-in's signedout mode answers auth status with loggedIn false, which is the only state this check asserts anything in

signin-turn.js.skip: wants the real CLI refusing a token as a synthetic api-error assistant line; the stand-in's signedout turn fails on stderr instead, which would pass without proving the claim

tab-drag.js.note: opens ten rail rows: the sample's hub/rim/spoke plus enough notes touched today to fill RECENT

thread-text.js.note: lifts a phrase out of a real answer's transcript; the stand-in writes none

title-late.js.skip: wants a hand-built transcript with no ai-title line (the thread fixture's has one) and spends a real turn

title-tools.js.note: needs a first turn that opens with a tool call; the stand-in makes none

title.js.note: not live: the stand-in's ok mode answers the turn and its namer one-shot returns a name, which is all this asks

usage-live.js.note: the README also runs it at STUB_USED 0.75 and 0.93 and in the dark theme; one entry holds the plain, light case

vault-change.js.note: a turn held open nine seconds for the question, then over for Change… with nothing running; main refuses a driven run's folder (LANES_VAULT), so nothing is relaunched

lanes-crud.js.note: the sample's lanes; the seed moves the Ada Lovelace thread into Garden and one more into a lane that is not there, so the delete has three threads to count and overrides to leave alone

settings-folders.js.note: the sample with no read-only folder, so inbox/ starts writable; makes two untitled notes

screenshot.js.note: Not a claim: the README's picture. Run with --shot docs/img and --seed '{"theme":"light"}' or '{"theme":"dark"}'.

palette-threads.js.note: every thread under THREADS, dated by its lines; note rows name their file
